name: Coilover car: MacPherson coilover front, five-link coilover rear (CEVT and Grzyb geometry)
source: The corner geometries are the library models macpherson_coilover and five_link_coilover. The vehicle data are assumed values of a compact car on street and track coilovers: sprung mass 1500 kg, 53 percent on the front axle, CG height 520 mm, wheelbase 2700 mm, cornering stiffness 1300 N/deg front and 1400 N/deg rear per tire at the static load, peak friction 1.1, Magic Formula shape factor 1.3, load sensitivities 0.25 (cornering stiffness) and 0.12 (friction) per unit load change.
